method.aggregation: Parse the call graph by indentation. Sum inclusive counts for matching nodes unless an ancestor already matches. This avoids recursive double counting. Per-thread sum of self counts is asserted equal to its root count. Callsite profile_lines are 1-based.
method.scope: Main counts use 5853 sampled stacks as denominator; they include blocked time and are not CPU percentages. Worker totals combine different pooled threads and have no process CPU-share denominator. Nested rows must not be added.
method.window: Profiling was requested immediately before the viewport handshake released the 512 MiB ASCII workload. Its 10.196 s duration exceeds the 8 s requested profile, so this profile represents the beginning of ASCII rather than both payloads.

io_routes.interpretation: Counts locate sampled stacks, not CPU time. Socket readv can be blocked waiting for the client. PTY poll is a timeout-zero readiness check; its samples can include syscall/kernel cost and must not be labelled exclusively blocked wait.

diagnostic_semantics: These diagnostic counters are separate 8 MiB ASCII + 8 MiB ANSI runs, with settling time after DSR; they are not counters from the 512 MiB profile.
cursor_only_frames counts any non-snapshot frame with zero cell spans (CellSync.zig:337), including scroll or other metadata; it does not mean that only the cursor changed.
frame_bytes is encoded cell-frame payload, not total Unix-socket traffic.
The repeated ASCII/ANSI lines make many scrolled screens identical. The observed ratio of empty-cell frames is workload-specific.
interactive_telar_allocs has zero delta, but VT/heap allocations increase and std.Io task allocator activity appears in the profile. This is not proof of zero process-wide allocation.

hypotheses.name: Coalesce cell publication before render/diff during sustained output
hypotheses.evidence: CellSync.prepare occupies 1386/5853 main sampled stacks, including 797 Pane.render and 366 Style.eql. The final separate diagnostic emits 2750 total frames, 2742 without cell spans, while scanning 10068033 cells. Client acknowledgement precedes presentation, permitting another frame immediately.
hypotheses.falsification: Compare a bounded publication-coalescing candidate against the current binary, keeping VT ingestion and per-client ACK semantics intact. Expect fewer prepares/scanned cells/frames for equal PTY bytes, higher DSR throughput, immediate idle echo and guaranteed delivery after the producer stops. Include unique-line output because this fixture repeats identical lines. No throughput gain is quantified by this profile.

hypotheses.name: Avoid duplicate foreground-group probes per output event when semantics permit
hypotheses.evidence: The foreground tcgetpgrp branch accounts for 416/5853 main sampled stacks. GenericPipeline.handle calls shellForeground on each PTY output completion; observation also samples the process group.
hypotheses.falsification: Measure a separately isolated change that reduces redundant probes without weakening foreground attribution, progress expiration or input authority. Verify transitions between the shell and a foreground child. Smaller observed main share than cell preparation; savings cannot be extrapolated directly to throughput.

hypotheses.name: Measure handoff and readiness-check overhead
hypotheses.evidence: Main futex wait is 3256/5853 samples and groupConcurrent 346/5853. Workers contain 2896 PTY poll samples. Existing read-to-ingest-to-next-read handoffs remain serial per pane; these stacks alone do not identify why the main thread waited.
hypotheses.falsification: Trace queue submission, task start/completion and PTY readiness, separating running time from scheduler/PTY/client waiting. Do not remove cancellation, make all PTY operations nonblocking, or infer IPC causation from socket readv stacks.

limits: One sampled run with profiling overhead; use the unprofiled replicated benchmark for throughput claims.
Wall-stack sampling includes sleeping threads, kernel calls and scheduler delay. Counts across threads cannot be interpreted as CPU percentages or added to main-thread percentages.
Cell preparation, render, blit and style-comparison rows overlap by ancestry.
poll(timeout=0) does not wait for future readiness by API contract, but its sampled presence can represent syscall/kernel work or scheduling; do not label all poll samples idle wait.
DSR measures write through terminal processing and response read, not GPU presentation, photon latency or completion of observation.
Neither a single profile nor the diagnostic counters establishes the causal speedup of the proposed changes or guarantees 80 MiB/s.
